questions.q: Why does David put a blindfold on the author?
o: To protect him from the sun
To take him to a random place and have him guess where he is
questions.e: In the video: "David stavlja povez preko očiju, to je zato što će me kidnapovati, odvesti u neki random grad u Srbiji".

questions.q: What is Geoguessr?
o: A game where you have five rounds to guess places on a Google map
questions.e: In the video: "Geoguessr je igra u kojoj imate pet rundi da pogodite pet lokacija".

questions.q: In which city does the author live?
questions.e: In the video: "pet lokacija u Vlasotincu, to je grad u kome živim".

questions.q: What will happen if the author guesses all five places in Vlasotince?
o: David will give him a car
David will take him to a random city in Serbia, and he will have to guess where he is
questions.e: In the video: "Ako pogodim svih pet lokacija u Vlasotincu... David će me odvesti negde usred Srbije i baciti u neki nepoznati grad".

questions.q: What was the result of the first part of the challenge?
questions.e: In the video: "Na kraju imamo 22500 od ukupno 25000 poena".

questions.q: What was written on the water pump in the abandoned village?
o: "Spring water from the Komarica source, number seven"
questions.e: In the video: "na ovoj česmici nešto piše. Izvorska voda sa Komaričkog vrela, broj sedam".

questions.q: Where did the author end up?
o: In Ljuberađa, between Pirot and Babušnica
questions.e: In the video: "Znači, nisu Gorčinci, ipak je Ljuberađa" — "negde smo između Pirota i Babušnice".

questions.q: By how much did the author miss in Ljuberađa?
questions.e: In the video: "Promašio sam za 160 metra... Za Ljuberađu, 4800. Ljudi, dobio sam 4800".

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: David mi stavlja *povez* preko očiju.
questions.e: Povez — blindfold, bandage.

questions.q: On će me *kidnapovati*.
questions.e: Kidnapovati — to kidnap, to abduct a person.

questions.q: A ja moram da se *snađem* bez ičije pomoći.
o: I will find my bearings, I will manage
questions.e: Snaći se — to find one's bearings, to find a way out.

questions.q: Za prvu lokaciju nam je dalo neku *njivu*.
questions.e: Njiva — field, cultivated field.

questions.q: Ono gore je onaj *vidikovac*.
questions.e: Vidikovac — a place with a good view; vid — view, sight.

questions.q: Na ovoj *česmici* nešto piše.
questions.e: Česma — a water pump, a street water source.

questions.q: Bukvalno su sve kuće *srušene*.
questions.e: Srušiti — to destroy; srušen — destroyed.

questions.q: Pazite koliki sam *slepac*.
questions.e: Slepac — a blind person; in conversation, a "klutz".

questions.q: Zašto mi David stavlja povez preko ___?
questions.e: Preko ("across, over") requires the genitive case: preko očiju.

questions.q: Odvesti me u neki random ___ u Srbiji.
questions.e: Odvesti u + accusative case; for inanimate masculine nouns it coincides with the nominative: grad.

questions.q: Ako pogodim svih pet ___ u Vlasotincu.
questions.e: After the number 5 the genitive plural is used: lokacija.

questions.q: Geoguessr je igra u kojoj imate pet ___.
questions.e: After the number 5 — the genitive plural: rundi.

questions.q: Umesto da sedimo za ___, igramo Geoguessr u pravom životu.
questions.e: Za in answer to "where?" requires the instrumental case: za kompjuterom.

questions.q: Bukvalno ispred ___, u centru.
questions.e: Ispred ("in front of") requires the genitive case: ispred opštine.

questions.q: Pogodio sam tačnu ___.
questions.e: Pogoditi + object — accusative case: lokaciju.

questions.q: Poslednja lokacija je bukvalno kod ___.
questions.e: Kod ("at, near") requires the genitive case: kod stadiona.
